entities.name: Andreas Stadler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andreas Stadler was an Austrian weightlifter who competed in the 1924 and 1928 Summer Olympics. In 1924 he won the silver medal in the featherweight class. Four years later at the 1928 Games he finished sixth in the featherweight class.
